name: animated-shiny-text
title: Animated Shiny Text
description: A light glare effect which pans across text making it appear as if it is shimmering.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AnimatedShinyText } from '@/components/ui/animated-shiny-text'
</script>

<template>
  <AnimatedShinyText>✨ Introducing Vue Magic UI</AnimatedShinyText>
</template>

props.name: shimmerWidth
props.description: Width of the light glare in pixels.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The text (and inline icons) to shimmer.
